name: Nocturnal-Tempest
description: There is no surface, only an endless fall through banded clouds: amber belts, cream zones, and storms wide enough to swallow worlds. Lightning flickers between the layers like thoughts of a vast mind.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Approach protocols for research outpost are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
Business at the outpost is steady and deniable. Newcomers are welcome, watched, and priced accordingly.
